citation.locator: Correction notice, entire body; corrected dates with dividend amounts unchanged from the August 9 declaration
citation.verbatim: The dividend amounts have not changed. The dividends will be payable on August 30, 2024 to all stockholders of record as of the close of business on August 23, 2024, not payable on August 20, 2024 to all stockholders of record on August 12, 2024 as previously disclosed.

changes.what: BRY position confirmation as of the corrected record date

D1.decision: Apply the corrected August 23 record date and August 30 pay date. Confirm 40,000 eligible shares and book the $6,800 gross dividend receivable. No election is available or required. Hold only the net-cash/withholding determination pending tax documentation and the applicable withholding-rate determination.

actions.action: escalate and hold: Determine and book the net cash/withholding amount only; gross dividend receivable processing may proceed
actions.note: missing document: Applicable beneficial-owner withholding documentation and tax-rate determination (e.g., valid Form W-8BEN-E and applicable treaty/statutory withholding-rate record)
